Test case: Reject operating hour updates that would make upcoming active shifts invalid
Role/Purpose: Chan cap nhat gio hoat dong neu con ca truc sap toi nam ngoai khung gio moi
Input/Scenario: Facility doi thu 2 thanh 08:00-17:00, nhung shift sap toi dang 07:00-12:00
Expected result: Throw ConflictException 409, tra impactedShifts va khong syncOperatingHours

Test case: Allow operating hour updates when upcoming shifts still fit the new wider hours
Role/Purpose: Cho phep mo rong gio hoat dong vi khong lam shift hien co bi sai
Input/Scenario: Facility doi thu 2 tu 08:00 thanh 07:00, shift sap toi dang 08:00-12:00
Expected result: Cap nhat thanh cong va goi syncOperatingHours

Test case: Preview operating hour impacts without saving changes
Role/Purpose: Cho FE xem truoc danh sach ca truc bi anh huong khi doi gio hoat dong
Input/Scenario: Preview doi thu 2 thanh 08:00-17:00, shift sap toi dang 07:00-12:00
Expected result: Tra canUpdate=false, impactedShifts co reason, khong goi syncOperatingHours

Test case: Wrap operating hour preview response after facility access check
Role/Purpose: Dam bao controller check scope va boc response preview dung format
Expected result: Tra message FACILITY_RETRIEVED va data preview

Test case: Reject active shift slots outside all facility operating hours
Role/Purpose: Chan tao khung ca active neu khong nam trong bat ky ngay mo cua nao cua co so
Input/Scenario: Facility tat ca ngay mo cua tu 08:00, tao slot 07:00-12:00
Expected result: Throw BadRequestException va khong save slot
